args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and spec
(FIN-212) require ROUND_HALF_EVEN. This caused the nightly test
failure in tests/test_money.py::test_half_even (e.g. 2.665 should
round to 2.66, not 2.67).

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py::round_money` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though the docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
Import and apply `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`. No signature or behavior-change other than the rounding mode itself.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed for commit `08d3cd5986` on this branch.
